WITH cf AS ( SELECT ea.user_id, ea.handle, ea.verification_status, ea.data_source, ea.last_sync_at, ea.weekly_count, ea.weekly_week_start, ea.all_time_count FROM external_account ea WHERE ea.platform = 'codeforces' AND ea.active_flag = 1 AND ea.status = 'active' ), internal AS ( SELECT fa.user_id, COUNT(*) AS solved FROM first_ac fa
WHERE fa.first_ac_at >= #{weekStartAt} AND fa.first_ac_at < #{weekEndAt}
GROUP BY fa.user_id ), manual AS ( SELECT md.user_id, SUM(md.count) AS solved, COUNT(*) AS declaration_count, MAX(md.updated_at) AS manual_updated_at FROM manual_declaration md WHERE md.active_flag = 1 AND md.verification_status = 'verified'
AND md.week_start_date = #{weekStartDate}
GROUP BY md.user_id ), base AS ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.school, u.email, COALESCE(i.solved, 0) AS internal_solved, COALESCE(
CASE WHEN cf.weekly_week_start = #{weekStartDate} THEN cf.weekly_count ELSE 0 END
cf.all_time_count , 0 ) AS cf_solved, COALESCE(m.solved, 0) AS manual_solved, COALESCE(m.declaration_count, 0) AS manual_declaration_count, cf.handle AS cf_handle, cf.verification_status AS cf_verification_status, cf.data_source AS cf_data_source, cf.last_sync_at AS cf_last_sync_at, m.manual_updated_at AS manual_updated_at FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN internal i ON i.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN cf ON cf.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN manual m ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'active' ), scored AS ( SELECT base.*, (internal_solved + cf_solved + manual_solved) AS total_score FROM base ), ranked AS ( SELECT scored.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_score DESC, internal_solved DESC) AS `rank` FROM scored WHERE total_score > 0 )
